Lyrics:Lyrics: \[Intro, Haunting Choir, Cinematic Strings, Sub-bass Swell\] (Whispered, building intensity) Tick... tick... BOOM— I don't wait, I don’t hesitate, no fumes Straight nitro in my veins, no brakes, no room (Yeah) See the chains? They rattlin’, shadows move... \[Drop, Industrial Percussion Enters, Heavy 808s\] (Distorted voice, robotic modulation) Break it down, let it build—watch the whole world tilt! \[Verse 1, Aggressive Double-time Flow, Pounding Drums\] I was born where the sirens wail, where the echoes linger but the lights stay pale Where the cold gets deep and the wolves don’t sleep, and the weak get preyed on—no fairytale I pivot, I switch, I ghost— Move like a phantom, I’m never exposed Shadowstep slick with the venom I spit, Every bar like a blade—watch me slit that throat! \[Tempo Shift, Half-time Beat, Bluesy Vocal Overlapping\] (Gritty, distorted blues vocal) Mmm, ain't no mercy here Gotta run these streets like I own this fear \[Pre-Chorus, Rising Tension, Orchestral Stabs, Gospel Choir Layered\] (Chanted, layered harmonies) RUN—Don’t slow down! FIGHT—Own this ground! MOVE—Ain't no doubts! LIGHT IT UP, LET ‘EM DROWN! \[Chorus, High-Energy Triplet Flow, Massive Synths, Layered Vocals\] (Yeah!) I don't break, I accelerate, no handbrake in my DNA Push that weight ‘til the levee shake, no backtrack when the rebels play Tick-tick-tock, time’s runnin’ out Pressure cookin’, I’m burstin’ out No rewind, no safe route— I AM the sound of the underground! \[Instrumental Break, Percussion Frenzy, Sudden Silence Before Impact\] \[Verse 2, Spoken Word into Explosive Rap, Atmospheric Pads\] (Low, menacing whisper) It’s the breath before the firestorm It’s the weight of every oath that’s sworn It’s the moment where the weak transform— Then BOOM—WARHORNS! \[Beat Switch, Hard-Hitting Drums, Complex Hi-hats, Layered Choir Harmonies\] (Rapid cadence switch-up, breathless delivery) Never been the type to fold, I decode, overload, then explode with the payload Every syllable I spit is a blade to the throat, break chains, innovate, leave ‘em comatose! I don’t comply, I amplify, multiply 'til the sky collides— I testify with a battle cry— Who gon’ stop me? TRY. \[Bridge, Ethereal Pads, Stripped-Back Vocals, Echoed Gospel Harmonies\] (Layered vocal harmonies, haunting reverb) They tried to write me off (but I rewrite fate) They tried to clip my wings (but I levitate) They tried to block my path (but I renovate) I make the rules now—I DECIMATE! \[Final Chorus, Climactic Drop, Explosive Bass Hits, Overdriven Synths\] (All-out intensity, choir soaring in the background) I don't break, I accelerate, no handbrake in my DNA Push that weight ‘til the levee shake, no backtrack when the rebels play Tick-tick-tock, time’s runnin’ out Pressure cookin’, I’m burstin’ out No rewind, no safe route— I AM the sound of the underground! \[Outro, Fading Choir, Subdued Drum Rolls, Echoed Whispers\] (Whispered, fading into the void) Tick… tick… BOOM.1y

(Female Vocal)\[INTRO\]\[Spoken Word – Jennifer Hudson Style\]\[Claps, Snaps, Foot Stomps\]\[Black Church Ambience FX\] (Female Vocal) \*Mmm… Lord…\* (Background: low hums, congregation shoutbacks – "Preach!", "Say that!") I don’t understand… how they expect me to. Forget… and forget? (Snaps, light tambourine shake) I say it like that… but I \*won’t\*. (Overdub: Gospel choir echoing her last line) \[VERSE 1\]\[Preaching Vocal Build – Jennifer Hudson Style\]\[Gospel Choir Overdubs\]\[Finger Snaps + Claps Only\] That smell… that place… Puts me right back in that space. My body’s here, but my mind stays trapped— Like a ghost still beggin’ to be unwrapped. (Background: "Mmmhmm!" "Come on now!") Never forgivin’ you. (Choir: \*“Never forgivin’ you!”\*) \[PRE-CHORUS\]\[Spoken-Sung\]\[Humming Harmony Stack\]\[Organ Swells\] (Lead) (Ohhh… tell me how… tell me why…) (Choir: "Why Lord?") (They say time heals… but these scars still speak your name…) \[CHORUS\]\[Full Choir\]\[Trap Kick + 1970s Gospel Loop\]\[Belting + Flow Intercut\] (Female Belting – Hudson power) 🎶 Whiskey burns slow… but your memory’s worse… (Male Adlibs – Pimp C style: \*“That’s real…”\*) Every line in my skin? That’s a curse. You left a prayer half-said… I’ve tried to be new… (Choir: “Tried to be new!”) But I’m never—\*never!\*—forgivin’ you. (Background: rising “Oooohs”, organ flourishes) \[VERSE 2\]\[Rap Flow – Pimp C Energy\]\[Choir Adlibs + Jennifer Interjections\]\[Full Beat Now Enters\] (Male Vocal – Slow Dirty South flow) Pendulum moods, I swing like I’m cursed, Some days I bloom, some days I’m the worst.
